description: This file defines the Galician (gl-ES) culture info for the DateJS library, including localized names for days and months, date and time formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone information, and prototype extensions for Date objects to handle culture-specific date operations.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero, effectively setting the time to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date instance to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day name across different formats.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns number of days in a specific month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the abbreviation for a timezone offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a specified weekday in its month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number of the year for the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the date to a specific week number.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number for the date within its month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for the date.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the date.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the current timezone observes daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts date to ISO string format.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Formats the date according to the specified pattern.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the parsing process for a date string.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple components of a date object based on configuration.
